dedupe_keys.name: sem plexos forecast model single electricity market ireland and northern ireland validated regulators market model with input files

description: The Regulatory Authorities of the all-island Single Electricity Market (SEM) of Ireland and Northern Ireland publish the PLEXOS production cost model that their Market Modelling Group uses for Directed Contract and capacity remuneration modelling. Each release comes with a validation and backcast report by NERA Economic Consulting, which checks the model inputs and compares simulated day-ahead prices and generator operation with actual market outcomes. Coverage: the all-island electricity market. The latest release, SEM-25-010 of 24 March 2025, covers 2024 to 2032 and provides the report, the forecast model input data as CSV files in two ZIP archives (14 and 21 MB), additional input files and a public version of the PLEXOS model; earlier releases include SEM-21-086 (2021-2029), SEM-20-004 (2019-2025) and a 2011-12 model with a backcast. Format and access: PDF reports and ZIP archives of CSV inputs and PLEXOS files; free. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: running the model needs a commercial PLEXOS licence, although the CSV inputs are usable elsewhere; the archives were not opened. Simulation uses: a validated, published set of market model inputs for market and capacity planning studies of an island system. Related records: the CAISO PLEXOS production cost models (model-caiso-irp-stochastic-plexos-production-cost-models) are a comparable published regulator model.
